'''Dreeson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he commanded a Republic spread of supplies across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Before he could complete his next supply drop, his ship was sabotaged by an Imperial spacer and was defeated.<ref name="TOR" />
